# peernode_kubernetes_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up an existing cluster of the account by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "peernode_kubernetes_cluster" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

output "web_hosts" {
  value = data.peernode_kubernetes_cluster.web.public_hosts
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `hourly_micro` (Number) Hourly price of the reserved size, micro-credits.
- `mode` (String) `autopilot`, `auto` or `pools`.
- `public_hosts` (List of String) Public HTTPS hostnames.
- `size_cpu_milli` (Number) CPU, millicores.
- `size_disk_bytes` (Number) Volumes, bytes.
- `size_memory_bytes` (Number) Memory, bytes.
- `status` (String) Cluster status.
